اشتهيا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَهَيَا (ištahayā) /iʃ.ta.ha.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# اُشْتُهِيَا (uštuhiyā) /uʃ.tu.hi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# اِشْتَهِيَا (ištahiyā) /iʃ.ta.hi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
